```python
import pandas as pd
file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/076c8171-9b3b-49b9-a477-244d2a532826.xlsx"
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, header=1)
# Identify the start of Zone 2 and restrict analysis to rows before it
zone2_idx = df.index[df['Name'] == 'Zone 2'][0]
zone1_df = df.iloc[:zone2_idx]
# Drop non-vendor rows
zone1_clean = zone1_df.dropna(subset=['Revenue', 'Rent'])
zone1_clean['rev_to_rent'] = zone1_clean['Revenue'] / zone1_clean['Rent']
min_idx = zone1_clean['rev_to_rent'].idxmin()
row = zone1_clean.loc[min_idx]
print(f"Vendor Name: {row['Name']}")
print(f"Revenue-to-Rent Ratio: {row['rev_to_rent']}")
print(f"Type: {row['Type']}")
```
